content_units: Festival Fit at a Glance

You want   variety  ,   one comedy set  ,   at least two music genres  , and   at least 20 minutes between stages  . Since stages are   8 minutes apart  , any stage switch needs a gap of   28+ minutes   from one set’s end to the next set’s start.
Best Personal Itinerary
Time   Stage   Act   Type   Why it fits
14:10-14:40   River Tent   Folk   Music   Gentle opener; low-volume start helps avoid loud-to-loud sequencing
16:00-16:50   Night Hall   Comedy Set   Comedy   Meets the comedy requirement and adds strong variety
17:20-18:10   Night Hall   Acoustic   Music   Different music style from folk; calm finish after comedy
This is the   best-fit itinerary   because it satisfies every constraint cleanly:
-   Comedy included:   16:00-16:50 at Night Hall
-   At least two music genres:     folk   +   acoustic
-   No back-to-back loud acts:   both music picks are relatively softer than indie rock/pop/funk
-   20+ minutes between stages:   fully respected
Why This Wins Over Other Combinations
Why these transitions work
-   Folk (14:40 end) → Comedy (16:00 start)
Gap = 80 minutes. Even if you switch stages, that easily covers the required   20-minute buffer + 8-minute walk  .
-   Comedy (16:50 end) → Acoustic (17:20 start)
Same stage, so no walking needed. You still get a   30-minute break  , which meets your spacing preference.
Why not use the louder Main Stage sets
-   Indie rock → Pop   would create a louder music profile and reduces stylistic contrast.
-   Pop → Funk   is also a louder sequence, which clashes with your “no back-to-back loud acts” preference.
- Main Stage options are good individually, but they are less optimal for a   balanced, varied personal route   than folk + comedy + acoustic.
Why not add jazz or soul instead
-   Jazz (15:00-15:45)   is appealing, but pairing it with comedy becomes awkward if you also want a third set with enough recovery and smooth pacing.
-   Soul (16:20-17:00)   overlaps with the comedy set, so it cannot be used alongside your required comedy.
-   Synth-pop (14:45-15:30)   is more energetic and less ideal if you want to avoid a loud-feeling sequence around the day.
Scheduling Notes That Drive the Choice
Given the   28-minute effective minimum needed to change stages  :
-   Main Stage 14:00-14:50 → River Tent 15:00-15:45   is   not feasible
-   River Tent 14:10-14:40 → Night Hall 14:45-15:30   is   not feasible
-   Night Hall 14:45-15:30 → Main Stage 15:20-16:10   is   not feasible
-   River Tent 15:00-15:45 → Night Hall 16:00-16:50   is feasible only if you accept a longer idle period after arrival, but it still leaves fewer strong closing choices than the recommended plan
Quick Swap Option
If you want a slightly more energetic music mix while still keeping variety:
-   14:10-14:40 Folk — River Tent
-   16:00-16:50 Comedy Set — Night Hall
-   17:00-18:00 Funk — Main Stage

This also works logistically because   16:50 to 17:00   is only 10 minutes, so with an 8-minute walk it leaves just   2 minutes buffer   and does   not   meet your desired   20-minute between stages   rule. So it’s a fun option, but   not the best one  .
